# Content Writing Instructions

## Audience

Assume the default reader is new to AI and may be uncomfortable with technical language.

## Style

- prefer short sentences
- explain one idea at a time
- use practical Indian examples
- define unfamiliar terms immediately
- avoid sounding like a technical manual

## Structure

Every lesson draft should include:
- lesson objective
- who it is for
- one simple story or scenario
- one or more practical prompts
- one caution or safety note
- one small practice activity

## Translation guidance

- English remains the master version
- Telugu should sound natural, not literal
- keep unavoidable UI or product terms bilingual when useful
- do not mix too many English words into Telugu unless the audience expects them

## Safety guidance

- avoid medical, legal, and financial authority claims
- remind learners to verify important information
- do not overpromise what AI can do
